challenges.claim: Secondary fix proposes wrapping findByHash + revoke in a SQLite transaction, but rotate() is an async function with await calls at lines 61-62 that happen AFTER the DB write. better-sqlite3 cannot hold open transactions across await boundaries, so the transaction would commit before the async operations complete, leaving the same race window.

Client-side test scenario (b) proposes importing apiClient.ts in Node with a mocked fetch, but session.logout() calls window.location.href which is undefined in Node.js, causing a ReferenceError that would make the test crash rather than pass or fail meaningfully.
